SMART ODPADY, approved-original continuation, batch 01 of 11. Create 6 NEW symbols for the EXACT SAME icon family as the attached USER-APPROVED ORIGINAL six-icon image. The attachment is the authoritative original, not a later thin redraw. Match its actual contour weight, rounded ends, rounded joins, optical scale, uncomplicated silhouettes and spacious interiors. Inspect the house wall, module-square border, calendar border and pin border in the attachment, and reproduce their line-to-icon-height ratio for every new symbol. Do not make hairlines or technical wireframes. Do not make heavy bold tubing. Do not reinterpret or redesign the visual style. Graphite #243128 outlines and a clearly visible lime #75BD25 accent in EVERY icon; both colours use the same visual line thickness. Pure flat 2D, empty open interiors, crisp solid contour edges. Layout: 3 equal-width columns by 2 equal-height rows on a pure white 3:2 canvas. Each cell is one invisible square; center one symbol in it, with generous equal margins and matching optical size. Use the same silhouette-to-cell scale as the supplied original. Do not include the six reference symbols as extra icons. Keep all cells separate and no overlap. Draw these exact subjects and orientations in row-major order:
1. top left: Front-view refuse collection truck, green windshield outline.
2. top center: Invoice document with green euro currency ring.
3. top right: Two people bust outlines, one green head ring.
4. bottom left: Three ascending bars, tallest outlined green.
5. bottom center: Gear outline with green central ring.
6. bottom right: Bell outline with small green notification dot.

Quality check: all 6 requested symbols, no extra objects, every symbol has a visible green accent; stroke weight and rounded terminal shapes must visually belong beside the original six at 24px. Follow the attached ORIGINAL directly. Do not use a previously generated thin master.

Medical plus, clock hands, underline and information-i are the same width as their containing outline. Only a round dot may be filled; other continuous marks stay monoline.

Keep the airy open interiors and rounded caps and joins of image 1. Solid graphite #243128 and lime #75BD25 only; each icon needs a green accent. Flat 2D, pure white background extending to all four edges. Do NOT reproduce the rounded page corners from image 1.
